purpose: Second silhouettes per length class so traffic does not repeat one body. Plain bodies: paint is tinted per vehicle and liveries are decals.
commonPrompt: Strict orthographic side elevation of one single vehicle, exact profile, camera perpendicular to the vehicle side at axle height, zero perspective, not a three-quarter view. The vehicle faces left and spans almost the full image width, all wheels resting on one horizontal baseline. Plain uniform flat light-gray background, no ground, no cast shadow, no environment reflections, soft even diffuse lighting without bright specular highlights. Realistic factory paint and fine credible details: panel seams, door handles, window frames and pillars, mirrors, lamps, tyres and wheels. Generic contemporary Japanese design with no brand logos, badges, emblems, readable text or licence plate characters. Clean reference for texturing a miniature Tokyo street model.
